notes.title: #KILLALLZOMBIES ❤ Valve Steam Deck™
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24152734/43833d2531655eeb49cb80a57df04ebfa2044fa4.png[/img]

Hi there, 

we are happy to announce that #KILLALLZOMBIES are 100% Steam Deck™ compatible, so you can play your favorite title on the go: solo, or with friends (just pair an external game controller with Steam Deck)!

Stay tuned for more exciting news and follow us.

notes.title: A new strategy!
notes.notes:
It's our pleasure to inform you that our game will be available soon.ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11205442/463df51f6e34572ec4e7e41f8efe034ea79e217b.jpg[/img]
"Business Tour" is a free to play multiplayer tabletop game. We've prepared for you daily tasks and gifts. You'll have to use all your wits to achieve victory.

Don't miss an engrossing competition for the title of Monopolist.
